title: Thermodynamic implications and observational constraints of interacting f(Q,T) gravity in FRW Universe (Shekh et al.)
efc_relevance: Adds first/second-law thermodynamic diagnostics on top of an interacting f(Q,T) = αQ + βT model with deceleration→acceleration transition. Complements arXiv:2604.21151 (affine-EoS f(Q,T)) on the thermodynamic axis EFC also lives on, and provides a worked entropy-current bookkeeping that EFC's S(r,t) flow can be benchmarked against.
ledger_action: Add to competitor-landscape ΔAIC table alongside arXiv:2604.21151; cross-reference framework:Jacobson-1995 and framework:Padmanabhan-2009; required thermodynamic-consistency row (GSL, T·dS ≥ 0) in WP1 recovery-conditions table for EFC's S-flow.
